name: Aeoliah Victory
reason: Mainly a new-age musician and music store (recordings, fragrances, art prints) rather than a teacher: no classes, courses or sessions are offered, his last listed events were in 2021, his YouTube is music videos often titled with healing claims (DNA repair, cellular regeneration), and his two non-fiction books are sold on healing and DNA-reactivation claims, so almost nothing passes the content rules.
